content.content: 1. Necessity per prerequisite: the clause dresses every refusal trigger with a channel and every naming rule with a line to render into — without any one of them, that part of the envelope is motiveless. Fail if any edge can be dropped without loss. 2. License: no element of the envelope contradicts any shall-refuse or shall-name wording; the line carries the required naming, it does not replace it. Fail on any contradiction, naming the contradicting rule.
content.rationale: Refusal form is where seven triggers and four naming rules meet one stream; the gate forces the envelope to carry exactly what they promise.
